title: 第25章 路行将至回头无岸纵死无悔第26章 亡于天劫
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“那方才的的感觉是什么？”忆无情疑惑道。
【当然是将你体内的不死神格激活呀，哎呀说了你也不懂。】
“所以说，这体质有什么用？有什么天赋神通？”忆无情双目放光，很是期待。
他也想拥有那些吊炸天的天赋神通与体质异象，毕竟这么帅的东西有那个男人不喜欢。
【当然有，不过嘛，需要你自己去发现。】系统神神秘秘道。
“切，无趣，那不死，是怎么个不死法，死不掉吗？”忆无情问道。
他还是很好奇这体质难道真的可以让自己不死吗？
【嘿嘿，宿主想知道的话，可以自己试试。】
闻言，忆无情脸色黑了起来：“试试？怎么试？死一死吗？”
【系统不知道哦。】
忆无情不再理会系统，而是闭上双眼，修炼起来，尝试入圣。
所谓登天境，就是修士登向天际的道路，而忆无情就是走到这条路的尽头，甚至超越尽头，走到了一处未知的路。
忆无情感受到自己体内有一道门，一道早已打开的门，而他仅仅需要走进其中，从而入圣。
入圣，便不再是凡修，真正的成为一名强者，一名在仙界足以开宗立派的强者。
登天境与入圣境的差距很大，一名普通的圣境足以轻松斩杀数百名登天境，就算是真正的禁忌天骄，在登天境也只是勉强可以斩杀一名普通入圣强者。
但就算是这样，也足以说明他们的潜力有多强，毕竟圣境与登天境差距实在太大了，原因就是入圣强者无一例外都已经“入道。”
所谓道，就是一种法则，一种无法言明的力量。
它可以是任何事物，可能是各种元素，也可能是各种事物，修士从引灵境开始，就已经开始在寻道。
到了圣境，修士对道的理解便有了雏形，这便是入道。
当然，因为入道很是艰难，所有有许多势力都是有传承之道的，这样能在前期打下更好的优势。

道有很多种，只要是自己走出的道便可自己命名。
当然，走出自己的道可不简单，能走出自己的道的无一不是绝代天骄。
在无数年前的仙界，能走出自己的道的屈指可数，因此当年的仙界很弱，但自从有了传承之道，仙界便慢慢强大起来。
所以说，散修想突破到圣境很艰难，除非是得到了大能的传承。
忆无情没有传承之道，当然，若是他想要，冷清璃定会带他去接受传承。
但忆无情自己的道早已定形，无需任何传承。
他的道，是自我之道。
通俗点说就是自己成道。
在忆无情看来，道可以是任何事物，那为什么不能是自己呢？
修行，修的是己身，又不是他物。
忆无情查过，在仙界从未有过这种道的出现，他很奇怪。
难道从未有人想过己身入道吗？
那为何还有那些什么掌之道，头之道什么的。
这条路可能有问题，但忆无情已经准备很久了，应该没什么问题吧。
他已经做了心理准备，身死的心理准备。
“梦兮，到时候可能有些不顺，你别担心，我能扛过去。”忆无情睁开双眼，看向一直看着自己的柳梦兮。
“知……知道啦。”柳梦兮没想到他突然睁开眼，有些慌乱的移开目光。
“可恶，怎么突然睁开眼睛，好尴尬啊！”柳梦兮暗自吐槽。
“不管了……突破吧。”忆无情心念一动，他便感觉自己体内好似有什么桎梏被打破了似的。
“噗！”忆无情忽地吐出一口鲜血，吓了柳梦兮一跳。

“此道……不通……”忆无情有些不可置信，他感觉到冥冥之中有一股至高无上的力量在阻止自己，自己根本无法抗衡。
content_en:
"Then what did you feel just now?" Yi Qingqing asked doubtfully.
[Of course it is to activate the immortal godhead in your body. Oh my god, you don’t understand even if I tell you. 】
"So, what's the use of this physique? What magical powers does it have?" Yi Qingqing's eyes shone with anticipation.
He also wants to have those amazing talents, magical powers and physical abnormalities. After all, there is a man who doesn't like such a handsome thing.
[Of course there is, but you need to discover it yourself. 】The system is mysterious and mysterious.
"Tch, it's boring. What kind of immortality is that? Can't you die?" Yi Qingqing asked.
He was still curious about whether this physique could really make him immortal?
[Hey, if the host wants to know, you can try it yourself. 】
Hearing this, Yi Qingqing's face turned dark: "Try? How to try? Do you want to die?"
[The system doesn’t know. 】
Yi Qingqing no longer paid attention to the system, but closed his eyes, started practicing, and tried to become a saint.
The so-called ascending to heaven realm is the path that monks take to reach the sky, and Yi Qingqing means walking to the end of this road, or even beyond the end, to an unknown road.
Yi Qingqing felt that there was a door in his body, a door that had already been opened, and he just needed to walk into it to become a saint.
Once you become a saint, you will no longer be an ordinary cultivator, but will truly become a strong man, a strong man who can establish a sect in the immortal world.
There is a huge gap between the Ascending Heaven Realm and the Saint Realm. An ordinary Saint Realm can easily kill hundreds of Ascendant Heaven Realms. Even a true forbidden genius can barely kill an ordinary Saint Realm expert in the Ascending Heaven Realm.
But even this is enough to show how strong their potential is. After all, the gap between the Holy Realm and the Ascension Realm is too big. The reason is that all the powerful people who have become Saints have "entered the Tao" without exception.
The so-called Tao is a law and an indescribable force.
It can be anything, it can be various elements, or it can be various things. The monks have been searching for the path since they started in the spirit-guiding realm.
When they reach the holy realm, the monk's understanding of the Tao begins to take shape. This is entering the Tao.
Of course, because it is very difficult to enter the Tao, many forces have inheritance methods, which can give them a better advantage in the early stage.
There are many kinds of Tao, and you can name it by yourself as long as it is the Tao you have walked out of.
Of course, it is not easy to walk out of your own way. Anyone who can walk out of his own way is a genius.
In the fairy world countless years ago, there were only a handful of people who could walk out of their own way. Therefore, the fairy world was very weak back then. However, since the inheritance of the way, the fairy world has gradually become stronger.
Therefore, it is very difficult for casual cultivators to break through to the holy realm, unless they have received a powerful inheritance.
There is no way to inherit Yi Qingqing. Of course, if he wanted to, Leng Qingli would definitely take him to accept the inheritance.
But Yi Qingqing's own way has already been established, and there is no need for any inheritance.
His way is the way of self.
To put it simply, it means becoming enlightened on your own.
According to Yi Qingqing, Tao can be anything, so why can't it be oneself?
Cultivation is about cultivating one’s own body, not something else.
Yi Wuqing checked and found that this kind of Tao had never appeared in the immortal world. He was very surprised.
Has no one ever thought about becoming a Taoist?
Then why are there those things like the way of the palm, the way of the head and so on.
There may be problems with this road, but Yi Qingqing has been preparing for it for a long time, so there should be no problems.
He has made psychological preparations, psychological preparations for physical death.
"Mengxi, there may be some difficulties when the time comes. Don't worry, I can handle it." Yi Qingqing opened her eyes and looked at Liu Mengxi who had been looking at her.
"I know...I know." Liu Mengxi didn't expect that he suddenly opened his eyes and looked away in a panic.
"Damn it, why did you suddenly open your eyes? It's so embarrassing!" Liu Mengxi secretly complained.
"It doesn't matter...let's break through." Yi Qingqing thought, and he felt as if some shackles in his body had been broken..
"Poof!" Yi Qingqing spit out a mouthful of blood, startling Liu Mengxi.
"This way... is unreasonable..." Yi Qingqing was a little in disbelief. He felt that there was a supreme power stopping him, and he couldn't resist it at all.
